Terms of use

Updated October 1, 2026.

Using the tools

CopySprig provides free character transformations and a curated symbol reference. You can use the generated text in your own projects, subject to the rules of the destination service and applicable law. Unicode characters themselves are not a proprietary font supplied by CopySprig.

Check the result

Characters can display differently, be read differently by assistive technology, count differently toward a field limit or be rejected by an application. Review text before using it in an important communication. Plain-text recovery can be incomplete and can lose case information.

Responsible use

Do not use the service to impersonate others, conceal harmful content, evade another service’s safeguards, infringe rights or carry out unlawful activity. Keep critical names, addresses and instructions in readable ordinary text.

Availability and changes

The service is provided as available, without a promise of uninterrupted service, compatibility, search placement or a particular result. We may change the catalog or tools. Nothing here excludes rights or liabilities that cannot legally be excluded.

Questions

For a bug report, a missing symbol or a privacy question, use the CopySprig project contact channel. Please do not include private text or account details in a public report.
